title: Can occupational therapy help children with autism who face difficulty in eating a variety of foods?
metaTitle: Overcoming Eating Difficulties with Occupational Therapy | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Learn how occupational therapy at Pinnacle Blooms Network can assist children with autism in overcoming their eating difficulties and broadening their diet.
html: Definitely. At Pinnacle Blooms Network, we understand that children with autism often face feeding difficulties related to sensory issues. Our highly skilled therapists use approved strategies to introduce new foods in a friendly environment and help make mealtimes a positive experience. By doing so, your child gradually gets comfortable with different types of foods, adding variety to their diet.
